literal_meaning: বাপ এবং ঠাকুরদার আমল বা যুগ
figurative_meaning_en: A long time ago, in ancient times
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই গল্প বাপ-ঠাকুরদার আমলের কথা বলে।
example_sentences_in_english: This custom is from grandfather's era.
That story talks about events from grandfather's time.
history: Refers to traditional attire like dhuti-panjabi from ancestral times, evoking generational continuity in Bengali society.
note: Variants reflect regional differences in kinship terms (ঠাকুরদা vs. দাদা).
